# Overview

This site is the working index for SPRFMO Scientific Committee Workshop 17 (SCW17) jack mackerel preparation materials. SCW17 follows the 2026 benchmark work compiled in the SCW16 preparation repository and is expected to focus on management-strategy-evaluation inputs, operating-model conditioning, candidate management procedures, performance metrics, robustness scenarios, and documentation for SC14.

- [SCW17 MSE Workshop Report [html]](https://sprfmo.github.io/scw17/SCW17-MSE-Workshop-report.html)
- [SCW17 MSE Workshop Report [pdf]](SCW17-MSE-Workshop-report.pdf)

# Training and Orientation

The [MSE training resources](SCW17-MSE-training.html) page links to the IOTC MSE introduction and Shiny app, plus the FAO Training Adventure course option. These are intended as optional orientation material before participants move into the jack mackerel-specific SCW17 documents.
